description.value: The study evaluated whether DRD4 VNTR genotype was associated with transient fMRI-BOLD responses to smoking cues in adult dependent cigarette smokers.

spans.text: The present study evaluated the relationship between carrying the DRD4 VNTR 7-repeat allele and transient functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) blood-oxygen-level-dependent responses to smoking cues among adult dependent cigarette smokers.

value: we hypothesized that smokers homozygous or heterozygous for the 7-repeat (or longer) allele of the DRD4 VNTR (classified as DRD4 L) would exhibit greater brain activation than their counterparts (classified as DRD4 S) in response to smoking cues (versus control cues)
we further hypothesized that these differences would be localized in regions supporting drug cue-reactivity

spans.text: The SWQ is a 32-item scale measuring nicotine withdrawal symptoms in the following dimensions: craving, negative affect, arousal, appetite, habit withdrawal, and three somatic symptoms subscales: autonomic, gastrointestinal, and respiratory tract.
